video:video.video:description: My husband, the Wolf King, even if you don’t recognize me after the reincarnation, I will still find you and fall in love with you.

video:video.video:title: No Escape From My Ruthless Alpha
video:video.video:description: "I only want her. She's my mate."Ella, a wolf-less maid, is forced to marry the ruthless Alpha Logan instead of her sister. She soon discovers that Logan is her mate and that he's not as bad as everyone says. As she falls in love with him, Ella finds out she's actually a royal princess...

video:video.video:title: Ms. Janitor Turned CEO
video:video.video:description: The female CEO disguises herself as a janitor to inspect the company, but little did she expect to be bullied by the manager. The manager dirties her clothes and even slaps her, threatening to fire her. In that moment, she takes off her coat and reveals a VIP card, saying, Take a good look at who I am. Who will be the one getting fired? You!

video:video.video:title: The Alpha King Is My Second Mate
video:video.video:description: Sasha is about to wed Alpha Spencer, but she’s rejected at the altar. As soon as Spencer makes her a slave, the handsome and powerful Alpha King Xander saves her and says he is her second mate! Poor Sasha can't believe it and she only wants to flee. But the Alpha King spoils her like a princess. She can’t help but fall in love with him. However, the Moon Goddess must be playing a joke on Sasha--Xander has vowed to kill Sasha’s kind because of the power she has.

video:video.video:title: Love Never Fades
video:video.video:description: Su Ye was framed by Su Ling, the adopted daughter of the Su family, and had a one-night stand with Qin Chongzhou, the president of the Qin family. Five years later, she returned with her children. She must make those enemies pay the price!

video:video.video:title: Shadowed Thrones
video:video.video:description: Felix Young, known as the Supreme, discreetly supports his wife, Madison Xavier, in her ascent to a higher position. However, the day she is appointed as the War God, Madison files for divorce. Disheartened, Felix is determined to reclaim everything he once granted her.

video:video.video:title: Love Again, My Princess
video:video.video:description: In my previous life, I mistrusted my driver’s son, who stole my money with his evil girlfriend and injected HIV into me!!! Now I’m reborn back to school, I will make him taste all the pain he’s given me, expose him in front of everyone for the crap he’s done, and get back in love with my handsome admirer, NYC’s top billionaire!

video:video.video:title: Found a Homeless Lycan to Be My Mate
video:video.video:description: To escape Vincent’s harassment, Isabella holds a tournament to find a strong warrior to marry. Unexpectedly, an unknown rogue named Ethan, accompanied by his daughter Lily, wins the competition and becomes Isabella’s mate. But Ethan is not just any rogue. He is Lycan.After the two switch roles, Vincent launches a surprise attack, forcing Isabella into a desperate battle. In order not to burden Ethan and Lily, Isabella chooses to face Vincent alone, but is quickly overwhelmed and faces imminent danger. At the critical moment, Ethan then easily defeats Vincent—becoming the hero who saves the damsel in distress.

video:video.video:title: A Deal With The Hockey Captain
video:video.video:description: Nerdy college girl Dora joins the hockey team as an assistant, secretly in love with Leo. After a humiliating rejection, she makes a deal with team captain Troy to help her win Leo's heart. As Dora transforms and gains confidence, sparks fly with Troy. But secrets, sabotage, and shifting feelings complicate everything.

video:video.video:title: Forbidden desires: Alpha's Love
video:video.video:description: The taboo romance between Adrian and Chloe in multiple identities.

video:video.video:title: Love by Confinement
video:video.video:description: Ava was sent to prison by Liam for causing the death of his friend. After being released, Ava was tortured by Liam and her love for him was tested to its limits, yet little did she know, Liam also endured incredible agony. In the end, the couple let go of their grievances and started a new life together.

video:video.video:title: Desired by the Billionaire Football Star
video:video.video:description: A billionaire NFL quarterback star issues a nationwide manhunt for the woman he had a one-night stand with.

video:video.video:title: My Quintuplets Have Four Dads
video:video.video:description: An ordinary girl accidentally saved a CEO. No one knew about the romance, but her identity was taken away by her gold-digging girlfriend. Afterwards, she was blessed with five babies! These genius babies became the fuse of love.

video:video.video:title: Mr. Williams! Madame Is Dying
video:video.video:description: Madison Evans loved Hunter Williams for 16 years, but was asked to be his mobile blood bank for White Moonlight, Andrea David. Hunter Williams destroyed her family, just to make room for Andrea David. A cancer physical examination report made Madison Evans see his cold-blooded and ruthless true face. When she finally didn't love Hunter Williams, she found that she had been infatuated with the wrong person for 16 years.

video:video.video:title: My Ex-Wife Is a Superwoman
video:video.video:description: She was everything I thought I understood—my wife, my partner, my equal. But after the divorce, I realized how little I truly knew about her. Behind the quiet strength she displayed during our marriage lies an extraordinary world I never imagined. As a renowned figure with unparalleled talents and a heart devoted to justice, she’s not just a woman but a force to be reckoned with. Watching her thrive from a distance, I can’t help but feel a mix of admiration, regret, and longing. She’s my ex-wife, but to the world, she’s a superwoman—and I’m still hopelessly in her orbit.

video:video.video:title: The Female CEO Turned Janitor
video:video.video:description: Who would have thought that the cleaning lady before our eyes is actually a female CEO with a net worth of trillions...

video:video.video:title: Return of the Lady CEO
video:video.video:description: Rich family Neil’s favorite daughter Catherine was drugged to have sex with a stranger, which was considered a disgrace to the family integrity. After being disinherited by her father, Catherine found out her own sister Renee and fiance Howard were behind all these to set her up and she was then pushed off the roof by them. Eight years later, Catherine came back to the city alive becoming lady CEO of a company to seek for revenge from her enemies. To promise her son a loving family, Catherine contract-married with the stranger father, George Donton, a powerful royal family heir but mistakenly taken as a pizza delivery driver by her. With the discreet help from the Donton family, and a dangerous accident that George saved her life, Catherine finally found out the truth about him and decided to love him with her heart. They joined hands to beat the evils over and restored the peace to the city...

video:video.video:title: Flash Marriage with my Alpha
video:video.video:description: Pregnant and rejected by my alpha mate. Today I had my first one night stand. It wasn't planned. It was also with a complete stranger. As I lay in bed, I paused when a familiar sense washed over me. The other side, my boyfriend, Ethan, was nearby, and he wasn't alone.You are so tight, girl, Only for you...

video:video.video:title: Revenge on my ex-husband

video:video.video:title: Prisoner of Love
video:video.video:description: Jason, new at Berlin Schwingert High, intrigued Joe. Joe, unaware he fell for a boy, felt drawn to Jasons depth. They discussed freedom and frequented their secret rooftop. Meanwhile, Joe, an avid chess player, bonded with an online opponent, whom he mistakenly assumed was a girl, sharing his feelings with Barron.

video:video.video:title: I Can Never be Yours
video:video.video:description: When fresh-faced college graduate Sheryl Davis has a one-night stand with billionaire Liam Anderson on New Years Eve, she never expects to become his secretary – or watch him mistake her best friend for his mystery woman! As their office chemistry sizzles, Sheryl discovers shes pregnant! Will Liam realize his perfect match has been right in front of him all along?

video:video.video:title: Je suis vraiment un Immortel ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Sophie croyait qu'elle avait dupé son mari Alex pour lui porter le malheur. Mais en réalité, Alex était parti hériter du savoir d'un vieil immortel. Cinq ans plus tard, Alex est passé d'un raté à un vrai immortel. Même s'il s'agit de l'élève d'un dieu de la guerre, un sachet de laxatif a suffi à le faire passer pour ridicule. Face à une tueuse, Alex a aussi retourné la situation. Le doyen de l'École Ombres était le domestique d'Alex chargé de nettoyer les toilettes !

video:video.video:title: Legally Bound To Love
video:video.video:description: The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

video:video.video:title: Return of that Banished Girl
video:video.video:description: Isabella grew up in a patriarchal home where she and her sister were mistreated in favor of their brother. Despite the odds, she got into Harvard but was forced to quit. With her mother’s help, she left, finished school, and became CEO. When she learned her family planned to marry off her sister to fund her brother’s marriage, she returned to save her mother and sister—this time, determined to fight back.

video:video.video:title: After Divorce: I Become Heiress
video:video.video:description: In order to get rid of her billionaire father’s overwhelming love, Sally hid her real identity as the wealthy heiress and chose to make her own living. Her husband Felix cheats on her. In retaliation, Sally married Aiden in a flash. Unknown to her, Aiden is CEO of Taylor family. After the divorce, Sally chose to reveal her identity but was jeered by Felix and others. Aiden didn’t believe her either. But when would Sally and Aiden know their real identities?

video:video.video:title: Reborn to Revenge: The Betrayed Luna
video:video.video:description: Melinda encountered Phillips and Laura, restraining her urge to confront them. She bumped into Nelson, who realized she was his Mate. Nelson's longing for her overwhelmed him as she walked away, leaving him in a maddening heartbeat.

Now that you are the CEO, there is a huge difference between us. But the flame of love was ignited again.

video:video.video:title: Lycan Princess Won't Be Your Luna
video:video.video:description: Alyssa, the lost princess of the powerful Obsidian Pack, awakens her hidden Lycan heritage after surviving a brutal attack. For years, she endured humiliation as the wolfless Luna of the Silver Moon Pack, married to Alpha Alaric in a contract to stabilize his cursed pack. When she discovers Alaric’s betrayal—his pregnant mistress and his family’s disdain—Alyssa leaves, reclaiming her royal identity. Reunited with her brother, the Lycan King, she uncovers a witchcraft conspiracy that suppressed her and Alaric’s powers. As they confront their past and a vengeful witch, Alyssa must choose between reclaiming her love or forging her own path as a leader. A tale of betrayal, destiny, and fierce redemption.

video:video.video:title: Head Over Heels With My Substitute Wifey
video:video.video:description: Due to a reckless incident where Grace White's younger sister, Amber White, drove under the influence, Woods Group CEO Richard Woods' sister, Alice Woods, has fallen into a coma. Grace's father and malicious stepmother hold her mother's funeral urn hostage, coercing her to marry Richard Woods in Alice's stead to make up for that incident. Little do they know that Grace has already shared an intimate encounter with Richard previously.

video:video.video:title: My Boyfriend Is an Ancient Prince
video:video.video:description: Cole Hart, the fourth prince from seven centuries ago, is killed by his own brother and time-travels to the year 2023, where he meets Nora Hart for the first time on a ranch. In the present, he is the son of a wealthy family, while Nora is also their long-lost daughter. With their complex identities and respective names, a story unfolds between them.

video:video.video:title: Fast and Furious
video:video.video:description: Once a world champion racer, Sanjay loses everything after a sabotage by his envious adoptive brother Shourya, leading to his father’s death. Homeless and broken, Sanjay gets a new chance when Ananya rescues him and unknowingly hires him as a mechanic. As fate unfolds, Sanjay re-enters the racing world under disguise, restores his identity, and defeats Shourya in a breathtaking championship finale—redeeming his legacy and exposing his brother’s deceit. Watch now.

video:video.video:title: Nikita: Alpha Kings 3-Time Rejected Mate
video:video.video:description: Nikita, a she-wolf from the poorest, weakest New Moon Pack, unexpectedly became the destined mate of the newly appointed Alpha King Vincent Spencer the day after her boyfriend betrayed her. Having been rejected three times before, Nikita had lost faith in love. She wanted to refuse Alpha King Vincent, but he adamantly disagreed. He recognized her as his savior and had fallen for her at first sight.Simultaneously, Nikita discovered that her parents had been brutally murdered, and their killer was hiding within the wealthiest, most powerful Full Moon Pack under Vincents rule. In order to avenge her parents, Nikita reluctantly agreed to become Alpha King Vincents mate and infiltrate the Full Moon Pack for investigation. Thus began a journey of love and bloodshed...

video:video.video:title: The Wallflower And The Alphas
video:video.video:description: Avery Williams is a high school senior wallflower and a transforming werewolf who has two identities inside. One is a wolf, the other is a Veela. Avery tries to handle her werewolf instinct, especially as the approaching mating time drives her out of control.

video:video.video:title: My Parents, The Undercover Billionaires (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: The wealthiest couple in the world, Dylan Earl and Helen Gray, finally reunite with their long-lost son, Ryan Earl. To test his character, they choose to disguise themselves as humble laborers when meeting him. To their surprise, Ryan not only accepts their background but also introduces his girlfriend, Alicia Finn, to them. However, the Finn family looks down upon Dylan and Helen, prompting Ryan to call off the engagement to protect his parents.

video:video.video:title: The CEO's Secret Love
video:video.video:description: Fifteen years ago, Gu Junxu met a girlBut when she appeared in front of him many years later, he...

video:video.video:title: Too Late to Regret, Ex-Hubby
video:video.video:description: Olivia Sterling lived in a loveless marriage with her cold and arrogant husband, James Sterling, for seven years. During this period, she witnessed her son Henry being gradually taken away by James ex - girlfriend, Victoria Clark. Olivia became an outsider. At Henrys birthday party, Olivia found herself completely ignored, and then proposed divorce that night. After leaving the cage named marriage, Olivia picked up her work as a talented translator of Joyce again and became closer with her friends brother, Tom Whitmore. At this time, James and son Henry wanted to win Olivia back, but found that the woman who was once regarded as insignificant by them was now out of their reach.

video:video.video:title: Fated to My Bad Boy Alpha
video:video.video:description: Abigail, a wolfless orphan, never expected that her mate would be Alpha Axel—the most infamous playboy in school.Just as they fall in love and start planning their future, Axel's ex-girlfriend returns, claiming she’s pregnant with his child……

video:video.video:title: Accidentally Brought a CEO Home
video:video.video:description: Nancy, a small-town girl, decides to marry Steven, a homeless man she rescued by chance. She does this to avoid being forced by her foster mother to marry the town bully. Nancy doesn't realize that Steven is the president of the Williams Group and is actually engaged to the heiress of the Thompson Foundation, who went missing years ago—and who is, in fact, Nancy herself. But then Lily stole her identity. How can Nancy get back what she's owed?

video:video.video:title: Taming My Billionaire's Ruthless Desire
video:video.video:description: Jade Garrison, once the adopted daughter of the wealthy Garrison family, faces betrayal and cruelty after the return of Olivia, the biological daughter. Framed and abandoned by her husband, Samuel Fisher, Jade leaves with their unborn child. Five years later, she returns to save her son but is forced into servitude by Samuel. As secrets unravel—Olivia’s manipulations, Samuel’s hidden love, and Jade’s true lineage as the lost heiress of the Carey family—their painful past collides with a chance for redemption. A tale of love, revenge, and forgiveness, where scars heal only when pride falls.

video:video.video:title: Never Mess with Mom
video:video.video:description: She, a quiet laborer toiling tirelessly on a construction site. All she wanted was to give her daughter a normal, peaceful life. But when her daughter was humiliated, bullied, and finally kidnapped at the prestigious school, her rage ignited. The once-invincible warrior who once shook the world, after twelve years in hiding, returned for her daughter! In a single night, the four great families bowed in submission, the underground organization The Mafia was obliterated, and even the Russian mob trembled in terror! They finally understood…The most fearsome wrath does not belong to the powerful and influential—but to a mother who would tear the world apart for her daughter! This is a mothers battlefield. Now betrayed she returns to reclaim it all!

video:video.video:title: Accidentally Pregnant with the Right Billionaire's Twins
video:video.video:description: Naive Sophie was tricked by her mother into becoming a surrogate—but the hospital made a mistake and used the wrong sperm! As her mother and brother pressured her to have an abortion, Sophie was driven to the brink of despair. Then she learned that she was carrying the child of a billionaire, Ryder! Feeling responsible, Ryder brought her home, and the two go went from strangers to developing a mutual understanding, with romantic feelings quietly blossoming. However, when her family learned the truth, they tried to extort money from her. After rescuing Sophie again and again, Ryder decided to propose to her. Then at the proposal, his ex suddenly appeared, throwing their relationship into jeopardy—will all these misunderstandings lead to everlasting regret, or will true love overcome the lies?

video:video.video:title: Stolen Heiress, Unstolen Love
video:video.video:description: Rebecca, a secret billionaire heiress, turned down an marriage to a powerful tycoon for her boyfriend of 10 years—only to catch him cheating with her best friend right in the office. The two, thinking they outranked her, subjected Rebecca to ruthless workplace bullying. Finally, she tossed her black card and revealed her true identity as their big boss, the two kneel in regret, begging for forgiveness. Meanwhile, Leonardo, the suitor Rebecca rejected, infiltrates the company to investigate his fiancée. Will he be able to recognize Rebecca? And can they finally fulfill their unfinished marriage?

video:video.video:title: Escaping the Mafia, I Married A Homeless Billionaire
video:video.video:description: To escape a forced marriage to a ruthless mafia heir, broke Uebr driver Myra impulsively claims a scruffy homeless man as her husband—only to discover he's actually the mafia heir himself. As secrets unravel and danger closes in, fake vows spark real feelings in this twist-filled, enemies-to-lovers romance packed with deception, desire, and unexpected redemption.

video:video.video:title: My Heartless Alpha
video:video.video:description: Rejected by her mate and cast out of her werewolf pack, Avery meets Ryan, the feared Alpha of the largest wolf pack in America. Despite the rumor of him being heartless, she finds herself falling for him, with an uncertain fate ahead.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] Ouvre les yeux, mon mari milliardaire
video:video.video:description: Hailey manque d'argent et cherche désespérément un moyen de payer les lourdes factures médicales de sa mère. Sa famille accepte de l'aider à condition qu'elle épouse le milliardaire Samuel Trent, plongé dans le coma après un accident de voiture presque mortel. Hélas, le tristement célèbre Samuel Trent ne tarde pas à se réveiller et découvre qu'il est fiancé à une parfaite inconnue.

video:video.video:title: CEO, Your Wife Runs Away with Your Six Heirs
video:video.video:description: After a night of passion, Evelyn Tomas gives birth to sextuplets. Six years later, a lovely boy stops billionaire Ethan Huntington and hands him a paternity test paper. He corners her and forces her to give him the child.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping for 30 years, My Brothers Kneel for me
video:video.video:description: Adopted by the Grayson family, May once enjoyed the love of three overprotective older brothers and the warmth of a happy home. However, after the Grayson family’s biological daughter Stella returned, May was treated as a “stand-in” and suffered betrayal and coldness. Misunderstandings and repeated emotional wounds left her heartbroken and disillusioned. Eventually, she volunteered to become a test subject in the “The May Project,” choosing to go into deep sleep for thirty years ...

video:video.video:title: Love’s Awakening: Unraveling the Schemes
video:video.video:description: After being schemed against by her ex-boyfriend, Ken Hood, Lyla Morris crosses paths with Ryan Hood and ends up marrying him, even though he has been in a coma. When Ryan wakes up, he is determined to marry the woman who saved him. Faced with numerous misunderstandings, the two finally resolve everything and embark on a happy life together.

video:video.video:title: Things I Hate About Us
video:video.video:description: He was known to be ruthless and ungrateful, but he doted on her after marriage. A woman is intoxicated in a gentle land. When a woman appears, she realizes that the tenderness and sweetness are all fake...

video:video.video:title: Sinful Love With Alphas
video:video.video:description: Adea, a prophetic female werewolf, navigates her dreams sensual mysteries. Encountering her persistent stepbrother Shane at Half Moons den, intrigue ensues. Amidst Shanes pursuit, the arrival of stepfather Joshua and his wife unravels hidden truths. A tale of desire, secrets, and family bonds awaits.

Business tycoon Ryder saves her... but then invites her to sign a BDSM contract, making her his "Kitten". Little does he know that she's actually the angel who saved him when they were young - the one he's spent a decade searching for.

video:video.video:title: Mon Coach, Son Frère ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Pour séduire son crush avant la fin des études, Agnès Hubel, première de la classe, demande à son frère aîné, au charme dangereusement envoûtant, de lui donner des leçons d'intimité. Elle découvre cependant qu'elle risque d'apprendre à aimer le mauvais garçon et que le frère de son crush pourrait bien devenir son véritable coach en amour.

video:video.video:title: Seduce My Ex's Brother-in-Law
video:video.video:description: After heartbreak and family collapse, piano teacher Emily is forced into the world of the elite to save her father. An unexpected encounter with Ethan,the sharp and enigmatic lawyer of the Hawthorne family, leads them to pose as lovers.But as trials, secrets, and betrayals surface, their staged romance grows dangerously real. Emily must summon courage and wit to fight back against the forces determined to destroy her family and future.

video:video.video:title: The Divorced Heiress Claims Her Crown
video:video.video:description: Caroline, the beloved heiress of the Donovan family and sister to three protective brothers, was born into a life of privilege. But for love, she concealed her identity and married Hayden, quietly supporting his rise for three years.Until betrayal struck — during a life-threatening childbirth, Hayden chose to save another woman’s child over hers. Heartbroken but resolute, Caroline divorced him, took her daughter, and began to rebuild her life. Now, Hayden must face the painful road to winning her back.

video:video.video:title: Daddy’s Kisses? No Thanks!
video:video.video:description: She and he met unexpectedly. Six years later, he was looking for his son, and her relationship with him warmed up in the company group. After all the twists and turns, can the little baby return to his father?

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] Beware My CEO Mommy
video:video.video:description: Casey, marked by a birthmark on her face, faced rejection from her fiancé. Uniting with her step-sister, they plotted against her, but fate intervened, leading her to a chance encounter with the wealthy Levi. Little did she know, Casey herself was the long-lost heiress of a prestigious family. Five years later, having taken control of the family business, Casey returns with a vengeance, accompanied by her child.

video:video.video:title: Please, Marry My Husband
video:video.video:description: Clara devoted twenty years to her husband and raised his two children, only to be betrayed by them all. Her husband plans a wedding—with her best friend as the bride, her own children standing by their side. Broken and humiliated, Clara decides to disappear, leaving behind a severance letter and a box filled with secrets—proof of everything they’ve done to her. But just when they think she’s gone for good, the wedding is interrupted by the one person they never expected to return. Love, guilt, and revenge explode in this twisted story of betrayal and rebirth.

video:video.video:title: Second Life, the Godfather's Wife

Ten years ago, they chose the day of their fiancé and lived a new life. Eleanor only wanted to live an ordinary life and chose to marry a beggar, while Vivian married Lucian. Unexpectedly, the beggar whom Vivian initially sneered at was actually the renowned Godfather. After enduring hardships, Eleanor finally became Godfather's Wife.

Her broken heart leads the goddess Hera, the guardian of all women, to bless Hedda with $50 Million. Hedda returns to her own life, determined to make her cheating ex-husband and his mistress pay, all while falling for the perfect man Hera blessed her with.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] Je suis une reine, pas une maîtresse
video:video.video:description: La femme la plus riche du monde, Sarah, revient aux États-Unis pour assister à la cérémonie de mariage de son fils unique, Teddy. video:video.video:description: As the strongest warden his fighting power is unparalleled, did not expect to be annulled.
