Unwilling to reveal his azoospermia, Kelvin secretly arranged for a sperm donor to get her pregnant. Meanwhile, Daisy struggled with her mother’s serious illness and Kelvin’s infidelity. One day, Daisy saved Rowan, the male protagonist, from a gangster’s attack, and he fell in love with her at first sight. Rowan secretly chose her as his contractual wife. When he discovered her pregnancy, he mistakenly believed she had been unfaithful. Heartbroken, he drowned his sorrows in alcohol, nearly giving the second female lead a chance to take Daisy’s place in his life. It wasn’t until Daisy was kidnapped that Rowan finally uncovered the truth—Daisy’s child was actually his. In the end, Rowan rescued her.

video:video.video:title: Never Meeting You After the Rain
video:video.video:description: After 7 years of hard work, the scumbag divorced her just to register Bai Yueguang's child? This time, she turned away in despair, and was later embraced by her childhood sweetheart and married in a wedding dress. The scumbag begged her to come back with red eyes, but she only said coldly, I don't love you anymore.

video:video.video:title: Against the Tide: A Youth Rewritten
video:video.video:description: Given a second chance at life, she was determined to rewrite her fate. First, she took her sisters and completely shook off their past identities as delinquents, resolutely breaking up with her incompatible boyfriend to start a brand-new life. By a stroke of luck, she saved someones life, and this person later took the initiative to offer tutoring to them, bringing a turning point to their academic pursuits.

video:video.video:title: I Wish You Knew
video:video.video:description: High school was a tale of sorrow for Shannon Wynn, but her final chapter introduces a cool guy who colors her youth with vibrant hues. From the moment she stepped into his world, greeted by Four Don'ts, Charles Channing, the cool guy, slowly but surely bridges the gap, defying those rules himself. The raspberry cake on a rainy day holds a special significance for her, about the ones she loves, and it is also a witness to her gradually overcoming her fear of dogs.

video:video.video:title: My Mute Wife
video:video.video:description: Cassie Rivers, the stepdaughter of the Hill family, endured bullying at school due to her inability to speak. Her stepbrother, Dylan Hill, stepped up to protect her, and on that fateful day, she fell in love with him.After graduation, she married the man she loved - Dylan, only to be informed that it was a sham marriage. Enduring both physical and emotional torment, she attempted suicide and lost her memory. However, he finally found...

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] Kim Is Mission Impossible
video:video.video:description: Kimberly and Darren, never having met even once, had been married for three years. Few people knew of their marriage. One night, she accidentally entered the wrong room and had a wild night with a man she thought was a stranger. The next day, she left behind ten dollars for the man and ran away, not knowing that he was actually her husband. Upon returning to her work, Kimberly was surprised that the new CEO was the man from her wild night...

video:video.video:title: Accidentally Pregnant, Forever Spoiled
video:video.video:description: Since childhood, Ella has lived with her remarried mother and stepfather after her parents divorced. She endured indifference and abuse in her stepfather's household. After her mother passed away, her stepfather and stepbrother treated Ella as nothing more than a tool to make money. Her stepfather even spent all of her college tuition, forcing her to work part-time to pay for her education.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] The Reckoning of Gold and Blood
video:video.video:description: While delivering food, Miles accidentally walked into a conflict between Clare and her uncle, Baron. Baron coveted Clare's family's goods and intended to seize them. Miles not only ruined his scheme but also selflessly shielded Clare, taking a fatal bullet for her. As a result, Clare developed feelings for Miles, believing he was meant for her. However, Miles was already engaged to Winnie. Winnie and her family were greedy, constantly demanding money in the days leading up to the wedding. Miles' mother, Martha, invested everything she had for her son's marriage but still couldn't satisfy their insatiable greed. After learning that Miles was being tormented by Winnie's family, Clare intervened without hesitation. Using her strength to intimidate everyone, she successfully took Miles away, and they held their wedding.

video:video.video:title: Destined Love
video:video.video:description: After being betrayed by a scumbag, she accidentally got married to the CEO. After the marriage, the CEO helped his beloved wife take revenge on the scumbag...

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] Ding ! Papa PDG est en ligne
video:video.video:description: Après avoir été piégée par sa propre famille, Marion est tombée enceinte de Denis Howard. Elle a donné naissance à un garçon qui s'appelle Paul. Malheureusement, à l'âge de cinq ans, Paul est atteint d'une leucémie. Afin de couvrir les frais médicaux, Marion décide de vendre le pendentif de jade que Denis lui a offert, ce qui déclenche une recherche de Paul dans toute la ville par la famille Howard. Pendant ce temps, Marion rejoint le Groupe Howard en tant que secrétaire de Denis. Au fur et à mesure qu'ils travaillent ensemble, leurs sentiments l'un pour l'autre grandissent et leur relation s'épanouit au fil du temps.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] The Celestial Sovereign's Silent Vengeance
video:video.video:description: Cayden Freeman, the Celestial Sovereign of Azra, married Juliette Frost while concealing his identity and secretly supported the Frost family for three years. After intervening to save Alessia Walsh, the second daughter of the Walsh family, from trouble, he earned the enmity of Odin Wells, the Wells heir, and was simultaneously thrown out by Juliette. At an investment banquet, when Cayden faced false accusations and public anger, Alessia appeared and skillfully diffused the situation, marking the beginning of their relationship.

video:video.video:title: Chasing My Frozen Wife
video:video.video:description: On her mother’s funeral day, Amber discovered her husband’s betrayal. After seven years of pursuit and fifty proposals, their marriage crumbled under lies and neglect. On their anniversary, heartbroken, she chose to freeze herself —leaving behind only her husbands bitter regret and unbearable remorse.

video:video.video:title: The Pharaoh Princess Raised Her Own Father
video:video.video:description: After taking an assassin's blade meant for her father, Egyptian princess Amenet awakens in modern New York — reborn as a billionaire dynasty's true heir. Armed with ancient divine power, she rebuilds her father's empire, shreds every enemy's scheme, and seizes the throne.

video:video.video:title: Throne and Kin
video:video.video:description: The Sterling family, led by Edward Sterling, is exposed for their involvement in power struggles and a grain monopoly conspiracy. Thomas Sterling conspires with Lord Ashford in a rebellion, leading to a rift between mother and son. Margaret Benson unveils their crimes and aids the common people, earning the support of His Majesty the Emperor. Her Majesty the Empress Dowager willingly steps down in disgrace. Ultimately, the Sterling family collapses, Lord Ashford's coup fails, and Margaret chooses to leave the palace, embracing a simple life. His Majesty the Emperor restores peace by quelling the unrest and reassuring the people

video:video.video:title: Drunken Sword: Conquer the Demon
video:video.video:description: Caleb Grant, Eva Croft, and allies seek revenge, uncovering a conspiracy involving the Surrey family and demon clans. They rescue Master Gale Croft, defend the Great Wall, and defeat the Surreys, with Eva ascending as the female emperor. Meanwhile, Drew Morris rejects an arranged marriage for Caleb, sparking new conflicts and adventures.

video:video.video:title: Chasing the Guilty Wife: The Indifferent CEO Knows
video:video.video:description: The maid Luo Wanwan turned around and became the wife of a wealthy family, but she was framed and killed by the male protagonist's biological eldest brother. She was tortured and escaped. Five years later, Luo Wanwan returned to China again to find out the truth of what happened back then. Her scumbag boyfriend also changed his feelings and finally led a happy life.

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Path Beyond Eternity
video:video.video:description: I love my school beauty wife very much, but I didn't expect that the male mistress would steal my wife! He even turned the tables and accused me of stealing her! Do you think you are rich? Do you want to see that I have a big boss grandfather? He has tens of billions of real estate! How dare you steal my wife!

video:video.video:title: The Wealthy Madame's Top Healer
video:video.video:description: The most beautiful girl in Lunan actually wants to marry Qin Feng! What magical ability does he have that not only wins the favor of the rich woman, but also makes the powerful bow down?

video:video.video:title: Lear, M.D., Lady of Hearts
video:video.video:description: She was killed by her stepmother while possessing a secret book, but she was reborn as an unpopular young lady in ancient times. As soon as she opened her eyes, she was forced to save a handsome boy. Fortunately, the handsome boy asked for a decree granting marriage, but who knew that he was actually Greedy for my body? !

video:video.video:title: You Were My Everything, Once(DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: As a token of gratitude, Morgan White agrees to Lily Oswald's grandfather’s request, hiding his true identity as a researcher and marrying into the Oswald family as Lily’s seemingly ordinary husband. For eight years, he tenderly cares for Lily and their child, but her heart remains with her first love, Brett Oswald.

video:video.video:title: My Heart Has Always Known
video:video.video:description: To save her mom from an abusive relationship with her father, Nina Judd agrees to take the place of her sister, who has vanished, in a marriage alliance with the heir of the powerful Zanes, Sean. Despite supposedly marrying into a life of luxury, she realizes her new husband is a workaholic who has little interest in her. Little does she know, her caring nature melts Sean's cold heart, and what appeared to be a marriage of benefit turns out to be the true love.

video:video.video:title: The Mafia Hunter
video:video.video:description: John Smith prepares for a public DSD swearing-in. Fiancée Emily cheats with Russo's Mark Wilson. John infiltrates Wilson's group, complicating his actions. Wilson bribes officials, exploits legal gaps, while John covertly disrupts his activities.

video:video.video:title: Tuned to Your Heart
video:video.video:description: At five years old, Luna York and William Grant are orphaned and eventually lose contact with each other. Years later, Luna mistakes Wilson Lowe for William and sacrifices her future for him at eighteen—only to face humiliation and mistreatment. Framed for plagiarism, she is rescued by the real William, who recognizes her but hesitates to reunite—until the truth finally comes to light.

video:video.video:title: I'll Be Better Without You
video:video.video:description: Luke, a gifted young football player, grows up with the Cole sisters and once promises to choose one of them after graduation. Yet the arrival of Wade turns the sisters against him, driving Luke to walk away in search of his own path and success. Only after his departure do the sisters realize their mistake and set out to bring him back.

video:video.video:title: Mafia Bad Boy is My Savior
video:video.video:description: Nova wakes from her first wet dream to a nightmare—her boyfriend cheating with her bully. Then Andre, the mafia boy wearing scars and tenderness she’s never known, steps out of the shadows to save her—and claim her heart.

video:video.video:title: Doormat No More: The Toxic Ex Licks My Feet
video:video.video:description: Charlotte signed a life-or-death contract to save her sister, agreeing to marry and work for Leo, the arrogant CEO of Carter Group. For three years, Leo has treated her like a doormat—belittling her, trampling her dignity, and taking credit for her success, convinced she’ll never leave. Now, as the contract nears its end, her old flame Harper returns. Will Charlotte leave Leo, reclaim her life, and reignite the spark with Harper? And will Leo realize what he’s lost?

video:video.video:title: Code of the Heiress
video:video.video:description: Legendary hacker Claire hides as a housewife but is betrayed. After divorce, she marries mysterious Daniel to take revenge and uncover her family’s dark past. Can she find truth—and true love?

video:video.video:title: MOVE ASIDE! IM THE EX BEYOND YOUR REACH!
video:video.video:description: Olivia and Derek die in a car crash on their way to divorce and are reborn as students. Seven years later, Olivia marries billionaire Asher, but a reunion with Derek and Jennifer leads to bullying and humiliation. Can Olivia fight back and take her revenge?

video:video.video:title: Superkid's Mission: Bring Mommy Home
video:video.video:description: The world’s most feared superhuman squad has one tiny secret: its strongest member is a little girl. Searching for their missing family, Claire and her father Adam return to the city, uncover a deadly conspiracy, and unleash their powers to protect the people they love.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] Baby Genius Saves the World
video:video.video:description: To save her grandfather, Ross Hanks, whose family was in dire straits, reluctantly agreed to divorce Zander at the insistence of the Morrison family. Additionally, she relinquished custody of the baby she was carrying to the Morrison family. Five years later, Ross's grandfather passed away, and Zander lost his memory in a car accident. Meanwhile, Ross received an unexpected offer from the Morrison family to work as a babysitter. With the help of the baby genius, they eventually uncovered the truth of what had transpired five years ago. Ross and Zander reconciled and found understanding, culminating in a heartfelt kiss and reconciliation.

video:video.video:title: The Unrivaled Overlord
video:video.video:description: Theo Larsen, alias the Overlord, commands a Wolf Army of a million strong. Shrouding his identity, he ties the knot with Sarah Welsh, the daughter of the prosperous Welsh family, securing the future of Glory Group before ascending to the pinnacle of his life.

video:video.video:title: How to Divorce a Billionaire
video:video.video:description: A female lawyer is unexpectedly hired by her estranged billionaire husband to be his divorce attorney. Amidst a series of misunderstandings, they rediscover their feelings for each other.

video:video.video:title: When Forever Only Means Five Years (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: When Helen Leonard went blind, Sheldon Hurst stayed by her side for five whole years—until his identity and credit were stolen by his brother. Betrayed and framed, he died full of resentment. Reborn, he tries to walk away from the pain, but the past won't let go. When a watch sparks false accusations, he's cast aside again. Only when Helen uncovers the truth does she realize her mistake—but by then, he already belongs to someone else.

video:video.video:title: Wrong Relationship
video:video.video:description: He is the handsome and promising chief of the military region. She is the daughter of a comrade he once rescued. This relationship seems to be that of uncle and nephew, but they cherish each other and fall in love with each other. Where should we go from here?

video:video.video:title: The Secret Marriage Scandal of Mr. Gu
video:video.video:description: Gu Tingchen hurt Han Chuyun again and again for his lover. She had already understood that she was wrong, and her mistake was falling in love with him. Spending three years gambling on an unknown outcome, Gu Tingchen exhausted Han Chuyun's love for him...

video:video.video:title: CEO, Your Wife Blocked You Again
video:video.video:description: Qiao Ruoxing had been in a car accident and almost lost her life, but her husband, Gu Jing Yan, was with another woman. In the past three years, she had watched Gu Jing Yan pamper that woman, and now, she was tired of this one-sided giving marriage, so she left after leaving a divorce agreement...

video:video.video:title: Five Years Later: Her Dominant Return with Her Two Babies
video:video.video:description: Five years ago, she was viciously retaliated by her relatives. Five years later, she came back with overwhelming hatred that shook the entire Haicheng.

video:video.video:title: From Small-Town Outcast to Blooming Rose
video:video.video:description: As a child loved by no one, Ava suffered unfathomable abuse from her father and grandmother. On the eve of being forced to marry a scoundrel, Ava managed to flee from home with her mother's help. Years later, Ava is now a powerful CEO and returns to rescue her mother, only to walk into her family's trap. But she's a victim no longer - this time, she's back to destroy them all and seize her long-awaited vengeance.

video:video.video:title: Fate Beneath Your Tender Torture
video:video.video:description: By day, Caroline is an icy corporate executive; by night, she masks up in leather and slips into an underground club, hunting the man responsible for her miscarriage. There, a mysterious younger aristocrat draws out desires she’s long buried— only to reappear days later as a new “intern” at her company. Is he an ally… or her next threat?

video:video.video:title: From Rags to Riches: Pet Shop Cinderella
video:video.video:description: By a twist of fate, pet shop owner Elise Moore got married in a whirlwind to billionaire Alexander Alger. Due to misunderstandings, Alexander had to disguise his identity to prevent him from being exposed. With Elise believing her husband to be an ordinary person, what kind of funny stories will unfold between them?

video:video.video:title: Christmas Homecoming of My Trillionaire Husband
video:video.video:description: Philip, the chairman of the Wharton Group and investor in the Ravenham Auto Plant, returns to his wife, Caroline's family to celebrate Christmas. However, unaware of his true identity, her family mocks and mistreats him and even tries to convince Caroline to divorce him, causing her to doubt Riley, until his true identity is revealed, shaming everyone who doubted him. Riley and Caroline reconcile and enjoy their Christmas together.

video:video.video:title: Rise of the Sun God: A Father's Vengeance
video:video.video:description: Lucien, son of the Sun God, gives up his divinity and throne for the mortal woman he loves. Six years later, he lives as a humble blacksmith, raising their daughter alone while his wife chases power. When tragedy strikes and she chooses another man over their dying child, Lucien loses everything. But the disgraced blacksmith has one secret no one sees coming: he was never an ordinary man.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] His Pregnant Wife On The Run
video:video.video:description: Rose Cole, a fresh graduate, ended up having a one-night stand with Thomas Gray, who was drugged, after covering her mother's night shift at a hotel. Later, when Rose applies for a job at Thomas Corporation, she happens to be hired as Thomas' assistant. After getting along with each other for some time, Thomas realizes that he has fallen for her. At this time, his girlfriend in name, Mia Jones, finds out their relationship and warns Rose to stay away from Thomas.

video:video.video:title: Eclipsed Power: The Legend's Awakening
video:video.video:description: Although Ian Cole has remained in the beginner stage for a century, he has built a team of elites, each reigning over their own territory. Just as he prepares for a millennial slumber, the immortals launch a devastating attack, leaving him gravely wounded and stripped of his former power, reduced to the mortal heir of the Cole family.

video:video.video:title: The Heiress' Return: Three Brothers at Her Beck and Call
video:video.video:description: Refusing to settle for mediocrity within her esteemed family, Mia Gale, daughter of the affluent Gale family, rejects the indulgent lifestyle offered by her three brothers. Instead, she opts to pursue her own path, determined to carve out success through hard work and dedication.

video:video.video:title: Loving You From the Football Sidelines
video:video.video:description: Brian, the agent, had a secret crush on football star Terry for seven years and finally decided to resign. Terry realized he couldn't live or work without Brian and vowed to do anything to get him back. Meanwhile, the mysterious man Brian had been secretly in love with became Terry's biggest rival in jealousy...

video:video.video:title: A Twist of Fate
video:video.video:description: Laurel York has been secretly loving Sean Leon since childhood but never dared to approach him due to her insecurities about her appearance. As adults, a twist of fate brought them together, but Laurel, fearing rejection, chose to hide her identity. Unexpectedly, someone else impersonated her, leading to a series of misunderstandings. Fortunately, the two ultimately overcame the obstacles and misunderstandings, finding happiness together.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping Beside Danger
video:video.video:description: On Jane Shaw's birthday, she barely survives a car accident. But the moment she wakes up, she witnesses a horrifying scene as her husband, Sean Cole, and their maid, Tina Holt, are plotting her death. In an instant, every dream and hope she once had for a happy life in a loving home shatters. The man she loves most has become her greatest enemy, and Jane finds herself trapped like a pawn on a chessboard, waiting to be sacrificed.

video:video.video:title: What Broke Wasn't Just the Vow
video:video.video:description: Alicia Blair spends years trying to be the perfect wife to Jasper Kane—only to discover their "perfect" marriage is nothing but a lie. Just as she gathers the strength to leave and files for divorce, Jasper realizes too late that he's truly fallen for her.

video:video.video:title: Divorcée, Maintenant la Princesse Lycan ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Rejetée par son puissant mari Alpha et contrainte de dissimuler sa grossesse miraculeuse, une humaine en apparence ordinaire découvre qu'elle est en réalité la Princesse Lycan disparue depuis longtemps. Lorsque son identité secrète s'éveille, elle reprend son pouvoir, met au jour les trahisons et défie la hiérarchie impitoyable des loups-garous. Elle lutte non seulement pour protéger son enfant à naître mais aussi pour choisir son propre destin.

video:video.video:title: Defying Doom: The Clash of Fate
video:video.video:description: In exchange for his divine powers as the Mystic Lord, Jason Long is destined for a short life. To change his fate, he embarks on a quest for the legendary Volatile. As events unfold, he becomes the live-in “unwanted” boyfriend of Rina Shaw, the heir to the prestigious Shaw family. Determined to protect her from his vengeful ex-girlfriend and a mysterious masked figure, Jason faces a series of challenges.

video:video.video:title: Plan B Bride: She Who Turned the Tables
video:video.video:description: Madge Pearce, a transmigrated daughter, marries into the infamous Marquis Manor in place of her reborn sister. By the time her long-missing husband—rumored to be a womanizer—returns years later, she has already built a fortune of her own. Yet the moment they meet, something about him feels strangely different.

video:video.video:title: Out of the Abyss: Ready to Strike
video:video.video:description: Falling into her stepsister Kathy Ford’s trap, Cindy Ford is severely injured and loses the Mystery Box that her biological mother left for her on the night before marrying Miguel Wood. Fortunately, she is saved by the Divine Healer, Ken Shaw. She returns after three years with the medical techniques she learned from Ken and the vast wealth of the Astral Alliance to ruin Kathy and Miguel’s wedding.

video:video.video:title: Beyond Betrayal: Her New Dawn
video:video.video:description: While concealing her identity as the world's top artist and the daughter of Jaxon's wealthiest family, Kate Snow embarks on a three-year relationship with Cedric Muhl. However, their bond shatters when Joan Larson, a manipulative woman, frames Kate to win Cedric for herself. Choosing to align with Joan for the sake of his family's future, Cedric humiliates Kate and even resorts to physical violence against her.

video:video.video:title: Not Your Second Choice
video:video.video:description: Growing up in a biased family, Aurora Smith suffers torment from a young age, and Lucas Shaw is the only light in her youth. Even as an adult, she still lives in the shadows of her family's mistreatment and is forced to marry a stranger for three million dollars by her parents and younger brother. Little does she know, a great turning point in fate awaits.

video:video.video:title: Love in a Fish Market
video:video.video:description: A powerful CEO on the run hides as a fishmonger’s housemate, sparking romance and chaos, until she discovers his true identity and vows, “I’ll still sell fish to take care of you!”

video:video.video:title: Fleeing from Mr. Lu
video:video.video:description: It tells the story of Lu Xiao who took out his mobile phone and was about to call his scheming wife for divorce, but was surprised to find that the wife he had always wanted to divorce was actually the girl in front of him who made his heart beat so much, Lin Wanyi.

video:video.video:title: A Heart Set Free
video:video.video:description: On the day Cora Irwin is set to marry Gavin Royce, her heart shatters when Gavin chooses Leila Black over her. Devastated, Cora ends their relationship and severs all ties with him. By the time Gavin realizes his mistake and regrets his decision, it is already too late.

video:video.video:title: Reborn, Reviled, and Ridiculously Loved
video:video.video:description: Betrayed, business legend Jane Spencer wakes up as Mira Quill, a rural woman who married the Hewitts' disabled heir in place of her stepsister. Scorned by those around her, she rises in high society and the business world, ultimately bringing down the abusive Quill family and the unfaithful scumbag who framed her.

video:video.video:title: Reversal Begins with Marrying a Beauty
video:video.video:description: A useless delivery boy is cuckolded, but unexpectedly gets the family inheritance! This time, the beauty proposed to him, and all the big guys knelt down to him! This is where your counterattack life begins!

video:video.video:title: Swapped Lives
video:video.video:description: The fate of Song Qiao, the heiress of the wealthy Ye family, is turned upside down when she is switched with the daughter of a maid. Ye Xingchen and Ye Zhenguo frame Song Qiao, while Ye Lanxin misunderstands her. Ye Xingli helps Song Qiao uncover the truth, and they fall in love. The conspiracy is revealed, the fake heiress is exposed, and Ye Lanxin faces her real daughter. The maid, the impostor, and the unworthy son-in-law are punished.

video:video.video:title: Blade of Destiny
video:video.video:description: Joe Lowe, the almighty Sword Sage, once conquered the world and stood above all. However, he could never forgive himself for causing his wife's death, so he punished himself by striking the Mending Stone ten thousand times every day. After 30 years, the stone finally split in half, but Joe, exhausted beyond his limits, took his last breath. Unexpectedly, his soul endured.

video:video.video:title: Madame le PDG aux Deux Visages
video:video.video:description: Un mariage coup de foudre après une rencontre arrangée, et voilà qu'elle découvre que son mari dirige un prestigieux groupe. Pour garder l'anonymat, elle se fait passer pour une femme de ménage dans sa boîte, mais sa cousine, avide de pouvoir, lui mène la vie dure. Poussée à bout, elle dévoile enfin son statut d'épouse du PDG. D'employée invisible, elle devient l'épouse influente d'un homme de pouvoir, prenant enfin en main les rênes de son destin.

video:video.video:title: The Wife's Counterattack [English]
video:video.video:description: Ouyang Mu married Liang Muqing only for Mu Qing's family property, but behind his back, he had already been involved with Mu Qing's best friend Li Feier, and Mu Qing already knew all this

video:video.video:title: The Childhood Friend I Couldn't Resist
video:video.video:description: Ethan, the richest man in the Capital, met the spirited young Sia while recovering from a serious childhood illness. Her encouragement helped him survive, but she disappeared before their promised reunion. Eighteen years later, they meet again. Afraid of losing her, Ethan rushes into marriage, only to discover that Sia has been part of the plan all along. From the very start, their love has been a two-way chase, culminating in a long-awaited, perfect ending.

video:video.video:title: The Wife Who Burned
video:video.video:description: Betrayed and framed, Katniss Frost returns under a new identity with her son. With vengeance in her heart and a mission to save her critically ill daughter, she decides to confront her ex-husband, Garrick Unwin. But this time, he's the one who's going to burn.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] Trois chances gâchées, papa hors jeu
video:video.video:description: Héritière des Kingsley, Karina sacrifie tout pour aimer William, son patron. Une nuit la lie à lui à jamais : elle porte son enfant. Ils se marient en secret… mais son cœur appartient toujours à Fiona, son premier amour. Des années plus tard, Fiona revient avec un fils. William choisit de le reconnaître en reniant celui de Karina. Brisée, elle s'accroche à la prière de son fils Galen : « Donne-lui trois dernières chances. » Et chaque chance perdue la pousse vers la sortie…

video:video.video:title: My CEO Son Kicks The Adopted Traitor
video:video.video:description: Joyce Shaw has been secretly drugged for years by her adopted son Felix and his wife, set to be a “heart donor” for his mother-in-law. On the eve of surgery, she uncovers the deadly plot and flees. Billionaire Jason Shaw recognizes her birthmark and confirms she’s his lost mother. But can he save her before it’s too late...?

video:video.video:title: Princess in Disguise: The Healer Who Saved a Dynasty
video:video.video:description: The seventh princess, Ariana Zeller, grows up among commoners while the emperor and her three brothers search for her. Saved by the former sect leader of the Sacred Healers, she rises to become the sect’s new leader. However, she hides her identity and repays a favor by marrying the top scholar—who secretly plots against her. Meanwhile, the princes arrive to reunite with their long-lost sister.

video:video.video:title: Back to Win It All
video:video.video:description: Betrayed by Elise Rowan, Nathan Chandler dies saving his daughter, Lila. Back in the '90s with a second shot, he cuts ties with Elise, builds his fortune, and heads for Southmere. But the past isn't done with him—and this time, he's ready!

video:video.video:title: The Man They Mocked, the Empire He Rules
video:video.video:description: After marriage, Elliot Lange dedicates himself to the Judd family to repay Connor Judd's kindness.However, his wife, Fiona Judd, returns pregnant with the seventh prince's child. Everyone mocks Elliot as a loser. In response, he terminates the marriage and reclaims his rightful place as a man of immense power. Only then does Fiona regret it—but what's broken cannot be mended.

video:video.video:title: The Royal Flame: Secrets of the Palace
video:video.video:description: Jason Ritchie, fleeing assassins, shares a night with Wendy Young, promising to marry her. Fearing for her safety, he leaves, only to return and find she’s gone. Wendy refuses to abort and raises their son, Joe. Years later, when their blood reveals Joe’s royal lineage, Wendy enters the palace to survive. But Helene Johnson, consumed by jealousy, will stop at nothing to destroy them. Can Wendy protect her son—or will the palace crush them both?

video:video.video:title: The Mafia's Obsession
video:video.video:description: Augusto Castro can't stand the thought of his only sister Alice getting hitched to some monster man due to an old-school marriage pact from 15 years back. He decides to pull a fast one on the agreement and steps in to marry the notorious mob boss, Pietro, in her place. Little did he know, it was all a love trap set by Pietro.

video:video.video:title: The Unwanted Wife of Atticus Fawn
video:video.video:description: Describing the love story between Autumn Rivera and Atticus Fawn, chosen as werewolf mates by the Moon Goddess. Despite love spells causing confusion, their magnetic attraction persists. Breaking through the enchantment, their true love prevails.

video:video.video:title: This Letter To You Is My Last
video:video.video:description: Ada, diagnosed with a terminal illness, spends the final moments of her life orchestrating a carefully planned farewell. Through it, her husband Frank—who had long despised and humiliated her—finally uncovers the truth that had been hidden from him, only to lose her forever in a sea of endless regret.

video:video.video:title: Married But Available: Perfume And Moon
video:video.video:description: Alpha Arthur's return marked a grand estate feast where he rescued Chloe, the butler, from noble Eileen's insults. Despite Chloe's engagement for her grandfather's sake and Arthur's subsequent departure, she silently worked at William Manor to cover medical expenses. Arthur, captivated by Chloe's talent, defied opposition and annulled the engagement. In a surprising twist, Chloe's awakened werewolf genes unveiled her as Arthur's destined mate.

video:video.video:title: Abyss of Misplaced Love: True to Deep Affections
video:video.video:description: She has been obsessed with the man she has loved for three years, but he is ruthlessly taking advantage of her. What should she do? Things were already unfortunate and difficult enough, but they accidentally provoked another man.

video:video.video:title: Le Héros Qui Marche Parmi Nous ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Florian Bellamy, le Maître Divin de Magnalia, vit simplement comme balayeur après sa retraite. Chassé de chez lui par sa belle-famille, il sauve une jeune femme qui lui présente sa mère, une femme d'affaires influente. Intriguée, celle-ci le teste en demandant à son amie de le séduire. Contre toute attente, Florian appelle la police, dénonçant la tentatrice comme une femme de petite vertu.

video:video.video:title: The Breaking Point of Love
video:video.video:description: After seven years of marriage, Kelly Jones’s husband, Eric Brown, remains cold and distant.Still, Kelly faces everything with a smile because she loves him deeply. On her birthday, she flies abroad to be with Eric and their daughter, Sophia Brown.To her devastation, she discovers that Eric has taken Sophia to meet her stepsister, Bella Jones—and Sophia even asks Bella to replace Kelly as her mother.Utterly heartbroken, Kelly finally gives up on him.

video:video.video:title: The CEO's Loving Obsession
video:video.video:description: Yamka Wright is a hardworking and ambitious girl whose life is constantly disrupted by her mother's preference for sons, pushing her to the brink of despair. In the depths of her struggles, Yamka encounters Xorn Ford while working at a bar. Xorn, the CEO of a publicly-listed company, has never been interested in women until he falls instantly in love with Wei Yuxian. As their lives intertwine, their affection for each other deepens. Xorn dotes on Yamka, fiercely protective and unwilling to let anyone mistreat her. Their love culminates in the birth of a child, and they live happily ever after.

video:video.video:title: Beneath the Ordinary
video:video.video:description: In a quiet, unremarkable neighborhood, Hugh Randall lives a seemingly ordinary life as a security guard. His days pass in routine—unnoticed, uncelebrated. But hidden beneath the surface is a genius-level business acumen capable of shaking the foundations of the entire industry.

video:video.video:title: Winning Back The Ex
video:video.video:description: Sheng Mian woke up to find herself lying in the same bed with her husband Fu Yancheng whom she had not seen in three years since marriage. She recalled being asked by her stepmother to toast Fu Yancheng last night, and after drinking, she became unconscious. She was momentarily embarrassed and prepared to flee, but was unexpectedly accused by Fu Yancheng of being a scheming woman. Obviously, he did not recognize herself as his wife.

video:video.video:title: Lullaby of Love
video:video.video:description: Ruby Owen works at a construction site and is often bullied by her superiors because of her humble background. One day, her best friend sees a news article about the wealthiest family in Jambera, the Smiths, offering one billion to anyone who finds their lost daughter, who has been missing for 17 years.

video:video.video:title: Pregnant by the Luxury Empire Heir
video:video.video:description: Sofia, a sales associate at a luxury boutique, and Bryan, the domineering CEO of a luxury conglomerate, unexpectedly have a one-night stand that results in her pregnancy. At work, Sofia faces bullying and sabotage from jealous colleagues, while at home, she is exploited by her mother and younger siblings for money. Throughout her struggles, Bryan steps in to confront her toxic coworkers and family, gradually becoming captivated by her resilience. Eventually, he proposes to her formally, and the two embark on a happy life together.

video:video.video:title: My Secretive Husband
video:video.video:description: An unpopular poor boy's son-in-law is actually a billionaire who has been away from home for three years. His mother-in-law made it difficult for him to buy a house, but unexpectedly he has an entire building...

video:video.video:title: Mulan
video:video.video:description: In that battle, Mulan single-handedly defeated sixteen war gods, defending the safety of her country. She fell down with serious injuries. In a state of blurred consciousness, she knew she was rescued by a man from the battlefield, but she didn't see his face clearly.

video:video.video:title: The Lost Son Returns as the Duke
video:video.video:description: Kidnapped as a child, Arthur, Duke of Mercia, returns to his village to reunite with his long-lost family. What he didn't expect was to find them abused by everyone in town. With his identity a secret, will Arthur be able to avenge them?

video:video.video:title: My Heart No Longer Beats for You (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Terry Ford does everything he can to win over Helen Yale, the woman known for her cool demeanor and distant heart. For six years, they're together—but not once do they cross the line into true intimacy. Then one day, the truth hits him: Helen has only stayed by his side in an attempt to bury her lingering feelings for their neighbor, Shaun Jensen. Hurt and unwilling to live in someone else's shadow, Terry makes the hardest decision of all—he walks away.

video:video.video:title: Too Much to Be Just a Mistake
video:video.video:description: Framed by her stepsister, Tina Moore unknowingly spends a night with James Jett. Two months later, she discovers she's pregnant—just before being sold off to James' brother as his bride. When her pregnancy is finally revealed, the Jett family erupts in fury—only to be stunned when James steps forward and claims the child as his.

video:video.video:title: Sisters Against the World's Judgment
video:video.video:description: Blaze was the revered Warrior Goddess of the Northern Realm. After completing her mission, she attended her sister Anna's engagement party but was looked down upon for still wearing her task uniform. Anna stood up for Blaze, who then used her strength to punish Anna's fiancé and his family. After that, Blaze introduced Anna to the worthy suitor, Zane. One day, Blaze and Anna unexpectedly encountered their parents, who abandoned them years ago. Blaze decided to take action on Anna's birthday, aiming to make their neglectful parents regret their choices for a lifetime.

video:video.video:title: Say I Love You When We Meet Again [English]
video:video.video:description: To ensure that Caius can have a heart operation, Freya had no choice but to part ways with him. Consequently, Caius came to despise Freya. At the same time, Caius' mother took away the boy born to Freya. Six years later, due to a fight between Freya's daughter and her classmate, Freya met Caius again. Thereafter, they were drawn into a painful and tormented love relationship characterized by alternating emotions of love and hatred.

video:video.video:title: Nothing But Money
video:video.video:description: After being abandoned by his girlfriend of three years, he suddenly learned that he was the heir of 50 billion property and met a beautiful and wealthy woman who wanted to marry him?

video:video.video:title: The Love She Lost to the World
video:video.video:description: Claudia Zabel is the daughter of the Judd family’s maid. She fell for Hector Judd the moment she laid eyes on him. However, Hector’s heart had long been claimed by his childhood sweetheart, Natalie Yowell. At seventeen, he was even blinded in a car accident while trying to save her. Natalie eventually left Hector for another man. Meanwhile, Claudia stayed by his side and devotedly cared for him for seven years.

video:video.video:title: The Uncle's Devouring Tenderness After Rebirth
video:video.video:description: On the day of their fifth anniversary with her husband, Bai Lu was killed by her husband and his mistress. She learned the truth. It turned out that her husband was not infertile, and the child she had worked so hard to raise was actually his and his mistress's biological child. Her five years were spent as a stepping stone for her husband's success. Bai Lu's heart was cut like a knife, and she was pushed into the abyss by her husband and mistress. Opening her eyes again, she was reborn and returned to three months ago; click on the material link below to see if Bai Lu can change her destiny in this life and launch a gorgeous revenge...

video:video.video:title: Beyond the Spirit Galaxy, He Commands All
video:video.video:description: Evan Carson transmigrates into a world where everyone can connect to the Spirit Galaxy. He fails to do so for three years straight, prompting the campus belle to cut ties with him. What she doesn’t know is that while Evan cannot connect to the Spirit Galaxy, he can connect to the Mythic Galaxy and make pacts with mythical figures to rise against all odds.

video:video.video:title: The CEO's Wife Stole Her Life
video:video.video:description: A struggling single mother unexpectedly lands a job at a luxury hotel, where she crosses paths with a powerful CEO—unaware that he is the man she had a one-night stand with nine years ago and the father of her son. As secrets, mistaken identities, and ruthless ambition threaten to tear them apart, she must fight to reclaim her life and her rightful place by his side.

video:video.video:title: Apocalypse Rising: A Zombie Saga
video:video.video:description: A shocking zombie outbreak rocks the quiet town, prompting Detective Megan and her deputy, George, to launch an investigation. They uncover a sinister plot involving a virus engineered to create the undead. Caught in the chaos is Colin, who shares a passionate night with Megan and now finds his family falling victim to the zombie hordes. As a biology professor, Colinlends his expertise to Megan in unraveling the mystery behind the zombie epidemic.

video:video.video:title: His Love Came After My Plane Crash
video:video.video:description: Valerie marries mafia heir Jeno, only to discover his mistress and secret twins. Pregnant with his child and shattered, she fakes a plane crash and disappears. When Jeno finally realizes what he has lost, his desperate pursuit comes too late, leaving Valerie free to begin again.

video:video.video:title: Wild as Hell: The Prince’s Saga
video:video.video:description: Shuangxu was abandoned by her family and grew up in the Shen household. In her naivety, she mistook her reliance on Shen Yu for romantic love. To preserve their reputation, the Shen family sent her abroad. Five years later, Shuangxu returns to her homeland due to a close friend's grave illness, leaving behind her feelings for Shen Yu. Upon her return, her work brings her into contact with Tingzhou. She never imagined that one day she would be involved in a clandestine relationship with him. Little does she know, this game is a long-planned seduction by Tingzhou.

video:video.video:title: Matriarch Reborn: Respect the Bloodline
video:video.video:description: Evelyn Roff, a physicist from the nation's early founding, wakes up 70 years later to find her once eight-year-old son now a grumpy old man with two troublesome grandchildren—a clueless CEO manipulated by a scheming beauty and a lazy underachiever. Unable to tolerate such an eyesore, Evelyn, now an 18-year-old great-grandma, steps in for a fate-writing family lesson.

video:video.video:title: Awakening to Life's New Dawn
video:video.video:description: There are too many regrets in his life, but things can never go back to how they were before. Even in his final moments, all Bruno Logan can do is pray for a chance to set things right. Surprisingly, his wish is granted.Opening his eyes once again, Bruno cries tears of joy. Futures trading, real estate investment, financial mergers and acquisitions, and international trading are all simple tricks up his sleeve, helping him to stand out and succeed.

video:video.video:title: A Dance Between Chains and Freedom
video:video.video:description: In her past life, Sarah Garner was sent as a hostage and tortured to death. Reborn outside King Cyrus' camp, she chooses a new path—captivating Cyrus with her dance instead of becoming a miserable prostitute. Though kept under threat, Sarah pretends to obey while secretly plotting revenge. She manipulates the man who once abused her and spreads rumors about Cyrus, all while staying close enough to slowly win his heart.

video:video.video:title: Love in a City of Knives
video:video.video:description: In the gritty streets of 1990s, a brilliant yet cold-hearted doctor with a dark past crosses paths with a ruthless but fiercely loyal mafia heir. What starts as a dangerous game of manipulation soon turns into mutual respect—and an unexpected love. Together, they navigate betrayal and survival, finding trust and hope in a world where every move could be their last.

video:video.video:title: Tides of Goodbye
video:video.video:description: Obeying her family's wishes, Gina Tillman marries her three childhood friends—only to face betrayal after betrayal. Branded as cursed and driven to despair, she ends her own life. Reborn with her memories intact, Gina takes a new path: she marries Cody Rowan and severs all ties with those who wronged her. Only after losing her do they regret their actions—but by then, it's far too late for redemption.

video:video.video:title: Trails of Hope: His Journey Back Home
video:video.video:description: Theo Levy lost contact with his parents 20 years ago due to a car accident. Fortunately, he was adopted by the chairman of Boyd Group, who raised him into the man he is today. Now that he has finally returned to his hometown, he swears to find his biological parents with the pendant he has.

video:video.video:title: Love on the Edge of a Cliff
video:video.video:description: Zhang Mingyue was framed by her ex-husband and her best friend and pushed off a cliff. In order to take revenge, she transformed into Jiang Xuesihu and reappeared in front of them.

video:video.video:title: Mother's Revenge
video:video.video:description: On the day of Lin Chaoge's engagement, her mother, Lin Meixian, went to the banquet as a cleaner and was given a hard time by the Yang family. The BMW woman grabbed the parking space, the mother-in-law set up rules, and the fiancé demanded a expensive meeting gift. Lin Meixian then exposed her true identity, Li Wei, Pei Yu, Ye Qin with ten billion dowry debut. Since then, Lin Meixian has shown her strength on many occasions, solved the crisis of the mainland group, and finally, due to the threat of foreign capital, she went to New York with Lin Chaoge.

video:video.video:title: Love Needs No Words
video:video.video:description: Three years ago, the eldest daughter Song Wan was caught in a fire at the Repulse Bay club. Lu Tingshen, who lost consciousness in her legs due to the fire, could never forget Song Wan who saved her, so she mustered up the courage to propose marriage to the Song family. In this way, the two of them started a life of testing and helping each other with their own secrets in their hearts.

video:video.video:title: Quand le cœur s'égare ( Doublé )
video:video.video:description: Suite à la faillite familiale, Naïs trouve refuge chez les Bailly, où elle grandit avec leurs deux fils qui la chérissent pendant vingt ans. Tout bascule avec l'arrivée de Mélisse, la fille de leur bonne, qui manipule la situation. Naïs finit par s'éloigner des frères Bailly. Ces derniers ne découvrent la véritable nature de Mélisse qu'après le départ de Naïs. Finalement, Naïs trouve le vrai bonheur avec Lucas, entourée d'une famille qui l'aime sincèrement.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] Accouchement sous Trahison
video:video.video:description: Doriane Muller, héritière du Groupe Muller, dissimule son identité et s'oppose même à sa mère pour épouser Louis Lefort, un homme sans argent. Pendant sa grossesse compliquée, Louis Lefort est influencé par son amie Thérèse Brun, qui accuse Doriane de simuler pour satisfaire sa vanité. Les tensions montent lorsqu'il veut transférer Doriane dans un petit hôpital. Raoul Muller, le père de Doriane, arrive avec des cadeaux pour soutenir sa fille, mais Louis et Thérèse le méprisent. Ce n'est qu'après la confirmation de l'identité de Raoul par plusieurs personnalités influentes que Louis les croit. Malheureusement, Doriane fait une fausse couche et divorce. Pris de remords, Louis invente un mensonge cruel sur Doriane et son père, déclenchant une vague d'attaques sur les réseaux sociaux. Raoul riposte en rassemblant des preuves et en alertant la police. Louis et Thérèse sont finalement condamnés pour leurs crimes.

video:video.video:title: Reborn from Hell, Dragon's Wrath (English-dubbed)
video:video.video:description: Logan Collins, heir to a wealthy family, was framed by his first love and sent to prison. While incarcerated, his family was tragically killed, and their assets were seized by his ex-girlfriend Jenna Grant's family. The only surviving relative is his young aunt. Fortunately, during his time behind bars, Logan mastered extraordinary skills—antiques, appraisal, gambling, medicine, and even cultivation. Upon release, he emerges invincible. Watch as Logan protects his only remaining family and navigates the urban jungle with swift justice!

video:video.video:title: Sir, Your Secret Son Is Five Years Old
video:video.video:description: Colin Fuller and Nora Scott were a couple in university. When Nora’s family goes bankrupt, another man forces her to marry him. Nora made the heartbreaking choice to leave him. Afterward, she discovers she is pregnant and decides to raise the child on her own. Many years later, Nora struggles in life, while Colin has become a successful businessman. As fate would have it, they meet again…

video:video.video:title: Overdrive: Rise of the Fallen
video:video.video:description: When top female racer Quinn dies in a tragic crash, her soul finds a new home in Chloe, a disowned heiress. To save her family’s struggling driving school, Chloe enters a dangerous racing event with a training car, shocking the crowd with her skill. But betrayal strikes—when her brother’s life hangs in the balance, she risks it all with a legendary drift. As enemies close in, her next move could rewrite her legacy… or bury the truth forever.

video:video.video:title: REBORN 2008: X-RAY VISION (English-dubbed)
video:video.video:description: Ethan Hayes travels back to the millennium with X-Ray vision. He finds Philip's artifact and Emperor Kane's porcelain. With Grace, he fights smugglers to retrieve lost treasures.

video:video.video:title: Yielding to Her Charm
video:video.video:description: Nina Yeats, battling a debilitating illness, becomes entangled with a monster, Jack Xavier, while trying to fulfill her late mother's last wish. Exploiting her vulnerabilities, Jack seems inescapable, yet Nina refuses to yield. As the icy facade of this devilish figure begins to crack, Jack finds himself unexpectedly bending to Nina's will. Nina discovers that Jack is not as fearsome as he seems, and slowly, she finds herself drawn to him.

video:video.video:title: She Chose Armor
video:video.video:description: Zenara Church, a retired War Lady, honors her father's dying wish to abandon battle. She weds Lucian Logan as her family's son-in-law, fostering him to become Martial Laureate—only to face betrayal when he takes a rival wife. After they scheme to seize her legacy and life, she re-dons her silver armor to reclaim her honor and defend the realm. Who says a true warrior ever truly retires?

video:video.video:title: No Time for Romance, Only Top Scores
video:video.video:description: Summer Gray, a struggling exam candidate, needs money for her grandmother's medical bills and the cost of preparing for graduate entrance exams. She signs a "stand-in" contract with wealthy heir Simon Trent, posing as his first love, Celine Klein, in exchange for a generous monthly allowance and exclusive study resources.

video:video.video:title: Bound in Your Glided Cage
video:video.video:description: Adriana was Nathan ’s secret lover for 3 years.Now she’s marrying someone else—and he goes insane.

video:video.video:title: (Dubbed)Claim What's Mine
video:video.video:description: At 18, Hannah Caldwell is adopted by the Caldwell family, only to be betrayed by her sister Juliet and imprisoned for ten years. After her release, she flees to Paris, leaving behind a life of pain. Five years later, she returns as Vivian Warren—stronger, fiercer, and ready for justice. But can she truly reclaim her life, or will the past haunt her forever?

video:video.video:title: A Recipe for Revenge
video:video.video:description: Wynne Sloan had it all: a business empire and a decade-long marriage to Frank Quinn—until a "car accident" took her unborn child and her ability to have more. She soon uncovers Frank's affair with her own sister, Yvonne, and realizes the crash was no accident. From CEO to betrayed wife, Wynne masterminds a cold, calculated takedown. She strips Frank of his titles, fortune, and sanity, while sending Yvonne where she belongs: behind bars.

video:video.video:title: How to Kiss a Vampire
video:video.video:description: Eight years after Vincent abandoned her, Ella—now a single mom—is pushed off a rooftop and saved by a mysterious, flying masked man. She wakes up to find Vincent at her side. He denies being the masked man but insists his enemies are targeting her and demands she move in with him for protection. Why is the man who broke her heart now acting like her savior? And why does he seem... not entirely human? Can Ella trust him again—or is he hiding more than just a mask?

video:video.video:title: Married To a Baller
video:video.video:description: Married To A Baller (Love and Football) - Charles Miles had everything: a beautiful wife, an adorable son, a fortune, a dream career as a pro football player, and his health. But after a terrible car accident, his life is about to change. Confined to a wheelchair, he must struggle with his flighty wife Victoria, his overbearing mother, and the arrival of Danielle, the one person who may be able to change his life, in order to one day walk again. This is his journey of overcoming obstacles, fighting for what is right, and knowing when to let go.
